[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 17::Three years.
]


For the price of trees or growing crops sold by the plaintiff to the defendant where no fixed period of credit is agreed upon.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the sale.
